notes: Eval 0 (full-redesign-dark-mode) is the only discriminating eval: with_skill 9/9 vs without_skill 5/9.

The four assertions the baseline fails are exactly the skill's distinctive VOCABULARY, not the outcome: the chrome-role indirections (--color-shell / --color-field / --color-button-2 / --color-seg), the card geometry tokens (--gutter / --radius-card / --shadow-card), the theme-independent ink tokens (--color-paper / --color-stamp / --color-brand), and the migration plan document (phases + decisions + definition of done).

The baseline DID build a token layer, freeze the light palette, add a dark theme with both resolution blocks, add a colour lint and split the god component. So the skill's contribution here is not "do tokens" — it is "use these roles and this vocabulary, and produce the plan".

Evals 1 and 2 are NON-DISCRIMINATING: both configurations score 100%. The baseline for eval 1 built its own token layer, an 11-component primitives set, a styleguide and a 16-check verification script; the baseline for eval 2 built a real React sandbox from the npm cache and diffed the markup across all 448 reachable states. Keep these assertions as regression guards, but they carry no signal about the skill.

A structural difference the assertions do NOT capture: the with_skill eval-2 run also split the stylesheet into ten ordered feature files (the method's Phase 7), while the baseline left styles.css byte-identical. An assertion on "the stylesheet was split into ordered feature files" would discriminate eval 2.

The with_skill runs used the skill's shipped lint-colors.mjs and contrast-check.mjs directly; the baselines wrote their own tooling. That is the "ship ready-to-copy artifacts" decision paying off — the skill run had working verification from minute one.

TIME COST: with_skill runs take roughly 72% longer (mean 2914s vs 1695s, both mtime estimates). Much of that is reading the skill (SKILL.md + 4 references + 7 assets, about 2,500 lines). A shorter "fast path" summary would cut this without losing the method.

Both configurations behaved honestly about their limits: each stated plainly that no browser, no npm install and no type-check were available on this host, and each recorded the exact commands to run once dependencies exist.
